mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wallet SET balance = balance + #{delta}, total_recharge = total_recharge + #{rechargeDelta}, total_consume = total_consume + #{consumeDelta}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND version = #{version} AND balance + #{delta} >= 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wallet(member_id, tenant_id, balance, total_recharge, total_consume, frozen_amount, version) SELECT #{memberId}, #{tenantId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_wallet WHERE member_id = #{memberId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, balance, total_recharge, total_consume, frozen_amount, version, updated_at FROM crm_wallet WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wallet SET frozen_amount = frozen_amount + #{freezeDelta}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND version = #{version} AND frozen_amount + #{freezeDelta} >= 0
